profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Focused and detail‐oriented Software Engineer offering exceptional troubleshooting skills and a talent for developing innovative solutions to unusual and difficult problems. Extensive knowledge of Web Development and Parallel/Distributed Computing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, I lead the development and management of complex software projects, ensuring high-quality code and efficient project execution. My role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that meet business objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Leadership: Oversee the development of our key product Sentinel Content hub. Infrastructure wise:  build shared libs, testing, pipelines, monitoring,  OKR boards, livesites from end to end. Lead innovated hackathon project ContentDiscovery AI and drive it into a full production feature, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to best practices.
Technical Excellence: Demonstrate expertise in frontend technologies, ensuring the highest standards of code quality, performance, and user experience.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with team members and other departments, 
Mentorship and Guidance: Provide direction and support to junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.
Problem Solving: Address technical challenges and blockers, optimizing performance and enhancing user experience.
Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies, continuously improving processes and methodologies.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · React.js · security copilot · Azure Sentinel · TypeScript · JavaScript

positions.title: JavaScript Software Engineer Lead (VP)
positions.description:
Work as a full-stack engineer lead building applications for bank customers
- Build micro front-ends using react, ember and other javascript libraries within Single Spa container
- Build micro services and access gateways using Spring Boot framework
- Deploy and host the applications on private clouds to leverage speed, scalability and more security control 
- Couch and lead junior engineers

positions.title: Solution Architect
positions.description:
Work as a lead front-end IT consultant, providing expertise for major airline and finance service provider companies in need of technological solutions.
- Build high performance applications in Angular/React along with component libraries
- Train and lead junior developers 
- Create Hypermedia client library to implement HATEOS (Hypermedia As The Engine Of Application State) driven REST API Architecture.
- Work closely with designers on translating mockups into applications.
- Integrate the front-end with Java spring based micro services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work as a lead developer on the platform team, collaborate closely with product manager, research, design and data scientist to upgrade user experiences and explore new features on the financial servicing applications of the company. 
- Implemented independent hosted micro front-end architecture with multiple frameworks: angular and react and running dockerizedly on AWS.
- Provided services to internal teams at platform level including building UI components build book, shared libraries, setting up governors and code reviews.
- Integrated with cloud based micro services backend.

positions.title: Web Software Developer
positions.description:
Design and develop a variety of complex web/mobile based applications using PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, MySQL and AJAX. Maintain existing code-base, troubleshoot bugs and add new features. Convert data from various formats (Excel etc.) into developed databases. Make updates to the MySQL databases. Update or develop new JSOM website pages using CMS Wordpress while maintaining overall UTD web policies, style & technology. Conduct usability & functionality testing.

Projects:
TARA: for department coordinators to view, assign, manage and download reports of teaching/research assistants. 
PHD Dissertation: for PHD students to upload and edit papers and professors to review, manage and download 
Students Trips: for administrators to add, view and manage student trip agreements and mobilities
Dashboard: for department deans to view and analyze students, alumnus, events and other related datas

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
70kft fortifies a consistent and dynamic online brand presence through: websites, e-commerce, mobile and web apps, tablet/mobile support features, brand-strong social media, display ads, email campaigns and large-scale product or service launches.
- Developed plentiful B2B, B2C websites frontend and architected various CMS backend structure. Delivered multiple works that convention responsive and visually attractive
- Developed multiple applications using MEAN stack and docker as deployment tool. The apps made important roles on achieving clients’ marketing goals

positions.title: Graduated Assistant
positions.description:
Assisting in Computer Science Lecture Classes, 
Instructing Lab Classes, 
Grading Students’ Homework, 
Tutoring students at office hour
